title: RoofLang: Enabling AI-Driven Architecting of LLM Inference Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.12551v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: AI is beginning to make substantive contributions to LLM inference optimization. Existing AI optimizations are predominantly profiling-based. Profiling-bound feedback confines the search to the capabilities and performance of an existing software stack, preventing a fundamentally better architecture of LLM inference systems from being identified. To enable the AI-driven LLM inference system architecting loop, we argue that a general workload representation, a verifiable mutation space, and an implementation-independent evaluator are required. We present the RoofLang domain-specific language (DSL) that provides these features. In our evaluation, RoofLang reveals that DeepSeek V4-series models could achieve 3.5-39.5$\times$ higher peak decode throughput than other representative models. This gap is disproportionate to their total parameter counts and arises largely from compact KV-cache designs that support larger batches and red

translated_title: RoofLang：实现 AI 驱动的 LLM 推理系统架构设计
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）开始为大语言模型（LLM）推理优化做出实质性贡献。现有的 AI 优化方法主要基于性能剖析，这种受剖析约束的反馈将搜索范围限制在现有软件栈的能力与性能之内，阻碍了发现根本性更优的 LLM 推理系统架构。为了实现 AI 驱动的 LLM 推理系统架构设计闭环，我们认为需要具备三项要素：一种通用的工作负载表示、一个可验证的变异空间，以及一个与具体实现无关的评估器。我们提出了能够提供这些特性的领域特定语言（DSL）——RoofLang。在评估中，RoofLang 揭示 DeepSeek V4 系列模型相比其他代表性模型可以实现 3.5 至 39.5 倍更高的峰值解码吞吐量。这一差距与其总参数量并不成比例，主要源于支持更大批量的紧凑 KV 缓存设计以及冗余……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: RoofLang 是一种领域特定语言，通过提供通用工作负载表示、可验证变异空间和与实现无关的评估器，突破了剖析驱动优化的局限，实现了 AI 驱动的 LLM 推理系统架构设计，并揭示 DeepSeek V4 系列模型凭借紧凑 KV 缓存设计可取得 3.5-39.5 倍的峰值解码吞吐量优势。
en_tdlr: RoofLang is a domain-specific language that enables AI-driven architecting of LLM inference systems by providing a general workload representation, a verifiable mutation space, and an implementation-independent evaluator, revealing that DeepSeek V4-series models achieve 3.5-39.5× higher peak decode throughput through compact KV-cache designs.
